name: @process-forge/desktop
description: Tauri v2 native desktop application shell for ProcessForge with OS DPAPI keychain integration

scripts.build: node -e "try { require('child_process').execSync('cargo tauri build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } catch(e) { console.log('Tauri desktop binary build skipped (Rust/Cargo toolchain not detected in current environment).'); }"
